svg.title: DiaGnostix wiring diagram for the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
svg.desc: AD8232 OUTPUT, LO+ and LO- to GPIO4, GPIO5, GPIO6; MAX30102 and BME280 on I2C SDA GPIO8 and SCL GPIO9; NTC divider to GPIO1; alert LED with 220 ohm resistor on GPIO15; optional buzzer on GPIO16; all modules powered from 3.3 V.
svg.text: All modules run from 3.3 V. Every 3V3 tag connects to the board’s 3V3 pin and every GND tag to a GND pin.
Pins are set in firmware/DiaGnostix/config.h; check your board’s silkscreen.
